semiconductor_relevance: Low — igus Korea primarily focuses on motion solutions and plastic materials, which do not directly pertain to semiconductor manufacturing or supply.
summary: igus Korea is the Korean subsidiary of igus®, specializing in motion solutions and plastic materials. They provide tailored technical consulting and services to meet the unique needs of the Korean market, although their offerings do not specifically target the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.Korea: igus Korea offers professional support of igus products and services to domestic customers.
